original_ai_output.title_zh: 琼莱州杜克与特维克东两县青年冲突持续，民众流离失所
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 据联合国南苏丹特派团（UNMISS）报道，南苏丹琼莱州杜克县与特维克东县青年之间反复发生冲突，导致当地民众恐惧与流离失所。UNMISS巡逻队因道路泥泞受损未能抵达部分地点，当地居民称被困于交火之中，行动受限、食物短缺。报道称，部分流离失所者面临饥饿威胁，而持续巡逻在一定程度上恢复了部分村庄居民的信心。

location.raw_text: Jonglei State, Duk and Twic East counties, South Sudan

key_facts.fact: 南苏丹琼莱州杜克县与特维克东县青年之间反复发生冲突，造成恐惧与流离失所
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: In South Sudan’s Jonglei State, recurring clashes between youth from Duk and Twic East counties have left fear and displacement in their wake.

key_facts.fact: UNMISS四天巡逻因道路泥泞受损被迫缩短，未能抵达杜克帕迪特和帕朱特
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Muddy and damaged roads prevented us from reaching Duk Padiet and Pajut, making Poktap our ultimate temporary base for three nights.

key_facts.fact: 当地居民称被困于交火之中，行动几乎不可能，难以购买食物和必需品
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Living in Poktap right now means being trapped in the crossfire. Our survival relies on traveling between Padiet and Twic East, but movement has become nearly impossible.

key_facts.fact: 一名流离失所妇女称其丈夫在帕朱特袭击中丧生
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Amou Ding Malang fled Panyang payam with her six children after violence reached Pajut, an attack that claimed her husband’s life.

key_facts.fact: 琼莱州代理州长派出两个委员会调解敌对行动
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the Caretaker Governor of Jonglei State dispatched two committees to engage local stakeholders and mediate an end to the hostilities.

uncertainties: 冲突具体伤亡人数未获确认
报道为单一来源（UNMISS），尚缺乏交叉验证
部分地点因道路受阻未能实地评估
